hypothesis: When settled-funding dispersion is wide and relative funding is persistent, a price-neutral long-low-relative-funding and short-high-relative-funding book earns the cross-sectional funding spread after costs.
falsifier: Falsify if persistent relative settled-funding dispersion does not support stable positive net performance across development folds and cost checks, or if the exact carry-sign inversion is comparably or more robust.
formation_horizon: 126 strictly prior settled-funding rows (nominally 42 days) plus 84 completed 8h price bars used only for quality and beta-neutrality vetoes.
rebalance_horizon: Every Monday at 00:00 UTC, with no target update between scheduled boundaries.
control_profile: Equal-dollar long and short funding tails; dispersion controls gross activation; funding persistence qualifies direction; absolute price movement, asset beta, and side-beta gap can only veto positions.
